audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers give Vayne levels 1, 2, 3 and 6 and call it a 4/10 favoured lane in green, against a 49.53% win rate over 1478 games; the audited Ornn side reads Skill at 2 and Ornn from level 3 through first item.
audit.why: diff already says 'HARD' while diffRating says 4/10 and report[14] says 'Favoured matchup' — the page contradicts itself before you even reach the chart. Mechanically Ornn owns levels 3-6: Volcanic Rupture creates the pillar that turns Searing Charge into a knockup on demand.
audit.corrected: Rows 1-5 to Skill, Ornn, Ornn, Ornn, Ornn as one atomic paired group, ratings moved with them, and the difficulty prose set to a hard lane.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page treats 'stand away from walls' as the whole rule and never states that Ornn brings his own wall.
audit.why: Volcanic Rupture (800 range, 9s at rank 1) forms a magma pillar at the end location after a short delay, and Searing Charge (450 range, 14s at rank 1) knocks up on any terrain collision. Open ground is not safe once the pillar is down.
audit.corrected: Volcanic Rupture's pillar is the wall his Searing Charge needs — the numbers written into the cooldown block and Do's.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[4], spikes[1] and late all say Final Hour's stealth dodges Call of the Forge God.
audit.why: Riot's text has the elemental travel toward him from up to 2500 range, with a recast to redirect it. Nothing in the kit says invisibility avoids it, and needsResearch is empty, meaning unknown. The verifiable facts — 2500 range, 140/120/100s, the redirect recast — are more useful anyway.
audit.corrected: Replaced the stealth claim with the range, the cooldown and the recast.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[1] through whys[5] all describe Vayne taking over on rows that now belong to Ornn.
audit.why: Row and explanation must agree, and Living Forge giving him bonus resists from every source is exactly what blunts the first-item window the page promises.
audit.corrected: whys[1]-[5] rewritten around Volcanic Rupture, Searing Charge, Call of the Forge God and Living Forge.

edits.before: - Ornn Volcanic Rupture: matchup-defining — Wall-knockup setup. Don’t get pinned. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Volcanic Rupture: 9s at rank 1, 800 range — its magma pillar is the wall Searing Charge needs. - Searing Charge: 14s at rank 1, 450 range. - Call of the Forge God: 140s. - Final Hour: 100s.

notes: suspectName on spikes[1] ('Final Hour's') is a false positive. Left alone, as the mirror audit also did: several strings describe Bellows Breath as a shield and as making him unstoppable. Riot's Data Dragon text says only that enemies hit by the final gout become Brittle — neither claim is supported, and neither is denied, so I did not repeat them or write against them. What Brittle actually does (damage amplification, CC extension) is likewise absent from the kit text, so no line I wrote depends on it.
